tools.name: crowd_perp
tools.description: Use before acting on a Hyperliquid perpetual to see whether it is crowded or in a hype state and what historically followed. Returns 7-day move, funding (hourly, APR, percentile vs its own 90 days and vs all perps), open interest and its 24h/7d change, premium, Wikipedia attention, active crowd stat

tools.name: crowd_states
tools.description: Every Hyperliquid perp currently in a crowd state (7-day moves of +50/+100/+200%, funding in its own top or bottom 5%, Wikipedia attention spikes, new listings), ranked by 7-day move, each with base rates for what followed similar states historically. Optional ?state= filter. Signed. Not investment

tools.name: crowd_market
tools.description: Market-wide crowding on Hyperliquid: breadth of 7-day moves, how many perps are up 50%+/100%+ in a week, share of perps with funding in their own top/bottom 5%, total open interest and its 24h change, BTC and ETH funding percentiles, and Wikipedia attention to cryptocurrency. Signed. Not investment

tools.name: crowd_changes
tools.description: For bots that poll: crowd-state events (a perp entering or leaving a state) since a timestamp, newest first, up to 7 days back. Each event is signed with the mark price at the time. Not investment advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base.

tools.name: crowd_history
tools.description: Signed historical crowd-state events for backtesting: up to 30 days per call, optionally filtered by coin and state. The archive is append-only and its daily hashes are published and Bitcoin-timestamped. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base.

tools.name: smart_perp
tools.description: Use before acting on a Hyperliquid perpetual to see how its most profitable traders are positioned: how many wallets in a 200-wallet smart-money cohort are long vs short, long, short and net USD, the 24h change, concentration, leverage settings, share of open interest, and how that compares with the

tools.name: smart_market
tools.description: Where Hyperliquid's most profitable traders are positioned across all perps: the cohort's overall net long or short, the coins it is most net long and most net short, the biggest 24-hour changes, and coins where smart money is positioned against the crowd. Cohort definition included. Aggregates only

tools.name: liq_perp
tools.description: Use before opening, sizing or holding a Hyperliquid perpetual position to see where forced selling or buying would hit: known longs liquidating within 1 to 20% below the mark and shorts above it, the biggest clusters, and coverage of open interest, set against order-book depth, spread and slippage a

tools.name: liq_market
tools.description: Liquidation pressure across Hyperliquid's largest perps: for each, the known longs liquidating within 5% below the mark and shorts within 5% above it, cascade ratios against order-book depth, 2% depth, how much of open interest the known positions cover, and flags; plus the coins with the most liqui

tools.name: annalist_about
tools.description: Free. What Annalist is, every tool and its price, how payment works (x402, USDC on Base), and how fresh the data is.

tools.name: annalist_baserates
tools.description: Free. Historical base rates for every crowd state: sample size, median and spread of later returns, chance of further run-ups. Optional state filter.

tools.name: annalist_market_sample
tools.description: Free. The crowd_market view as it was 24 hours ago, to evaluate the data before paying.

tools.name: annalist_track_record
tools.description: Free. Every crowd-state event's later outcome, compared with its backtest base rate.
